name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Manager | 0-to-1 Launches, AI-Native Marketing Systems & Technical Messaging
summary: Marketing operations leader and 0-to-1 builder with 15+ years in B2B SaaS and MarTech. Founded and built Solenzo from scratch, architecting AI-driven, agentic marketing systems for clients and translating loosely defined business intent into precise AI prompts and agent logic, hands-on daily fluency with ChatGPT and Claude as production tools, not just talking points. Took a brand-new Wix vertical from proof of concept to a profitable line, building the messaging, training, and enablement materials that got it there. Writes technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for B2B audiences.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems for B2B clients, translating non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions, the bridge between business intent and reliable LLM output.
Break down manual marketing workflows into agent architectures with custom logic, building and launching new automated capabilities from a blank page (0 to 1) for each new client engagement.
Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides on systems architecture, CRM optimization, and operational growth for B2B audiences.
Build reusable messaging frameworks and boilerplate marketing assets, adapting a shared template base to each client's brand and category rather than starting from scratch each time.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, backed by tracking across sales enablement, marketing, and operations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs to cross-functional stakeholders.
Produced high-converting campaign assets, landing pages, complex email sequences, and conversion-focused copy, improving lead generation and pipeline.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Sold and onboarded 15-20 reseller partners onto Birdeye's proprietary technology solution, translating technical product capability into a customer-facing value proposition partners could resell.
A meaningful share of that partner book sold specifically into agencies focused on healthcare clients, direct B2B marketing-technology experience in a healthcare-facing vertical.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to translate structured partner feedback into roadmap input.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a brand-new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, a 0-to-1 launch built from the ground up.
Built sales training and enablement materials for tenured account executives and new hires as that vertical scaled, translating a new capability into a repeatable, sellable narrative.
Managed a high-value account portfolio, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, translating technical product capability into business value for C-suite buyers.
Built Zapier automations as part of client implementations, hands-on automation-building history running from 2018 through the present at Solenzo.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate — Google/Coursera
